{{Quote|But Old Republic records chronicle the Vultar Cataclysm, an event in which the activation of an artifact known as the Cosmic Turbine destroyed that system. I suspect this Turbine was of Celestial origin. Unfortunately, gentlemen, travel to the Vultar Nebula is interdicted.|Edited transcript of the debriefing of Doctor Insmot Bowen|<ref name="Author's Cut" />}}
The '''Vultar Nebula''' was<ref name="Author's Cut" /> a part of the [[Arrowhead]] region in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TEA Vultar" /> In [[4250 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> a group of [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] activated a set of machines that were thought to have been used by the enigmatic, long-disappeared [[Celestial/Legends|Celestials]] to construct the [[Vultar system/Legends|Vultar system]]. The activation of those devices, however, [[Vultar Cataclysm|destroyed]] the entire [[Star system/Legends|system]],<ref name="GH39">{{TORcite|type=codex|Galactic History 39: The Third Great Schism}}</ref> leading to the creation of the Vultar Nebula. In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], the [[Obroan Institute for Archaeology]] researcher [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Insmot Bowen]] participated in a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] debriefing on the Celestials and noted to the Imperial authorities present that travel to the [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] was regrettably interdicted.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Vultar Nebula was originally meant to be mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]; however, the section that would have mentioned the nebula was cut before the book's release. The information regarding the Vultar Nebula was later released in [[2013]] as part of [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]], a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Fry and [[Del Rey]] editor [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] containing various cut content from ''The Essential Guide to Warfare''.<ref name="Author's Cut" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Vultar [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the Vultar Nebula, in grid square L-10.<ref name="TEA Vultar" />
